kicker_candidates: SME IPO from the 20 Microns group
Specialty chemicals player seeking listing on NSE Emerge

beats.beat: The company's products fall into four categories: Functional Additives (FA), Chemically Modified Minerals (CMM), Soft Minerals (SM), and Hard Minerals (HM).

It does not have its own sales force. Instead, it has a long-term arrangement with its corporate promoter, 20 Microns Limited, to market and sell products through their network. This is a core dependency.
Customer concentration is high: the top 10 customers accounted for about 59% of revenue in FY2015, FY2016, and FY2017.
The company exports to Nigeria, Saudi Arabia, and Sri Lanka, with total exports of ₹1,068.18 lakh over the past five years.
It lists strengths: diversified product portfolio, diversified user industries, import substitution potential, support from the holding company, and continuous R&D.

beats.beat: All figures in ₹ crore (converted from original ₹ lakh). The company reported net profit after tax (PAT) turning positive from FY2015 onwards after losses in FY2013 and FY2014.
Net cash from operations (₹ crore): FY2013: 1.25; FY2014: (3.50); FY2015: 8.03; FY2016: 4.22; FY2017: 1.28; H1FY2018: 2.01. The company acknowledges negative cash flows in prior years.
Total assets (₹ crore) stood at 30.19 in FY2013 and grew to 34.25 by H1FY2018.
As of September 30, 2017, contingent liabilities stood at ₹29.11 lakh (₹0.29 crore).

beats.beat: Promoters: Mr. Chandresh S. Parikh, Mr. Atil C. Parikh, Mr. Rajesh C. Parikh, and 20 Microns Limited (corporate promoter).
Promoters hold 89,48,270 equity shares — 99.76% of pre-issue paid-up capital. The promoter group (excluding promoters) holds the remaining 21,510 shares (0.24%).
Related-party transactions exist as per Accounting Standard 18, detailed in the financial statements. The company has entered into such transactions in the past and may continue.

There have been instances of non-filing or delayed filing with the Registrar of Companies (RoC), with additional fees paid. Also, some statutory licenses for one manufacturing facility (Plot 9-10, GIDC Waghodia) have not yet been obtained.

beats.beat: The specialty chemicals market (excluding agrochemicals and dyestuff) was estimated at ~₹1,000 billion in FY2017, growing at 10–12% CAGR from FY2014 to FY2017, and forecast to grow at 12–14% CAGR.

Key growth drivers include rising consumption, urbanisation (31% in 2011, expected 36% by 2020), GDP growth, and government initiatives like the Draft National Chemical Policy and 100% FDI in the sector.
Within specialty chemicals, segments like construction chemicals, water chemicals, and personal care ingredients are expected to grow at 15% CAGR.
The industry is highly fragmented, with SMEs holding 70–75% market share, but global players with scale and R&D capability dominate innovation.
Headwinds include stricter environmental regulations (e.g., REACH for exports to EU) and higher imports than exports in the chemicals sector.

beats.beat: 20 Microns Nano Minerals processes and sells specialty chemicals — functional additives, chemically modified minerals, and soft/hard minerals. It operates under the marketing umbrella of its corporate promoter, 20 Microns Limited.
The company has a pre-issue paid-up capital of ₹897.00 lakh (89,70,000 equity shares of ₹10 each).
Promoters hold 99.76% of the pre-issue equity, leaving only 0.24% with the promoter group.
The IPO is a fresh issue (size not disclosed) to fund a new manufacturing facility and for general corporate purposes, and to list on NSE EMERGE.

intro.purpose: Orient the reader: who the company is, what it does, and why this IPO matters.

beats.beat: The IPO is a fresh issue of equity shares (size and price band not disclosed in the excerpts). It is an SME listing on NSE EMERGE.

Net proceeds will be used for: (1) capital expenditure on a new manufacturing facility at Plot 336, GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, Gujarat; (2) general corporate purposes; (3) creating a public market for the company's shares on NSE EMERGE.
Lead manager: Vivro Financial Services Private Limited. Registrar: Link Intime India Private Limited.

offer.heading: The Offer & Objects
offer.purpose: Detail the offer structure, use of proceeds, and lead manager.

beats.beat: 1. Heavy reliance on corporate promoter: The company depends on 20 Microns Limited for marketing and sales under a long-term arrangement but no formal long-term agreement exists.
2. No long-term contracts with customers or suppliers: Sales are governed by purchase orders; raw material supplies are not committed, exposing the company to volume and price volatility.
3. Negative cash flows in earlier years: Net cash from operations was negative in FY2014 and volatile thereafter, which could constrain growth.
4. Missing statutory licenses: The company has not obtained all required licenses for its manufacturing facility at Plot 9-10, GIDC Waghodia, and may face penalties.
5. Intense competition and pricing pressure: The specialty chemicals industry is fragmented, with competition from global giants and new entrants, potentially eroding margins.
